name: Baby Seal
description: Meet Baby Seal, a 1.5-year-old Pitbull Terrier mix full of love and smiles galore! Baby Seal is a playful and confident pup who’s ready to bring energy and joy into her new home. Whether she’s chasing toys, exploring new sights and smells, or charming everyone she meets, Baby Seal dives into life with enthusiasm. She’s a curious adventurer who’s always up for fun and loves being the center of attention. She may not be looking for a doggy sibling, but she is looking for a household full of love! If you’re looking for a spunky sidekick who’s full of love and spirit, Baby Seal might be your perfect match. Come meet her and see if she’s the shining star your home has been waiting for!

name: Howdy
description: Yee Howdy, y'all! Meet Howdy, yer new beliked pardner who's got a baker's dozen of love to provide you with. This little lady is a 1-year-old Cattle Dog mix, so you just know she's always up for some doggone fun including playtime, goin' fer a jog, or just entertaining herself. She's here to be your number one cowhand with every passing day. Howdy's looking for a home full of fun, love, and snuggles. She adores laying her big head in yer lap for pets and whatnot. Now, of course, she'd like you to get here soon — not latish — so she can talk a donkey's hind leg off with you. Howdy's ready to lasso your heart; do you feel the tug? Come meet her today – she's two whoops and a holler away!

name: Champ
description: Meet Champ! This 2-year-old Pitbull Terrier mix is ready to meet his people. Originally from Fresno Humane, this boy didn't have a lot of weight on his bones so now he's making up for lost time — and he always has a pep in his step as he explores the city. Champ is equally excited going for a stroll with you or cuddling on your lap. We notice that he loooooves to meet new people, and when he plays with toys, he pounces on them! He's phenomenal at entertaining himself; just give him some toy options and watch him go! Champ is ready to learn new things using positive reinforcement training: he takes treats, sits on command, and wants to check in with you often. He may jump (he's endlessly excited!) but he's learning how to be better with each passing day. If you want a total sweetheart who's truly showing his silly personality, Champ's a great fella to meet!

name: Colocho
description: Colocho's no trouble; he's the best! Meet Colocho, a distinguished little English Cocker Spaniel mix who came to us from our neighbors at SF Animal Care and Control. Colocho is very ready to find his new abode. He's absolutely lovable but the shelter environment is not up to par for him; it's positively quarrelsome. This guy prefers fine dining, exquisite toys, and cuddles crafted specifically for him. Colocho is adamant that he is the ideal household dog. Affectionate, playful, and curious, he just needs an adopter whose adoration will provide him with only the finest. He deserves it! He may remind the riff raff that he's top dog, but he's learning every day how to become his posh-est self. If you want a dog who's endlessly charming and will always be an excellent dinner guest, Colocho's your man!

name: Jimbo
description: The name Jimbo tells you so much and yet so little and this fella definitely lives up to expectations. Meet Jimbo, a very handsome 10-month-old Pittie mix who came to us from our neighbors over at SF Animal Care and Control. Lively and enthusiastic, Jimbo loves every facet of life! He's an excitable young boy who's just as goofy as his name may suggest. Jimbo loves learning and is very treat motivated; always ready to practice his skills! He's looking for an adopter who understands his teen dog energy and joy and is ready to help him understand how to become his best, most mature self. You'll get to see him prance around with a rope toy and settle down when he's done. Come meet Jimbo today and help him learn who he can be!

name: Krypto
description: Krypto's your superdog! Meet Krypto, an adorable 4-year-old Husky mix who is ready to be your saving grace in any situation. Just like his comic counterpart, he's a smart goofball who likes to show off a mischievous side, while actually being the most loving dog you'll ever meet! Krypto adores making friends with people and dogs alike; it just takes some snacks or playtime to get him going! This fella also holds the special title of well-trained! He already seems to know many cues from sits, to downs, to stays. He may even be crate trained! He can get a little eager out on walks but with some delicious snacks, he'll be happy to check in with you to your heart's content. Training with this dog is both a breeze and a joy and he'll never show you anything but an enthusiastic, cheerful smile. Ready to take on the world? Come adopt Krypto!

name: Jackie
description: So, obviously Jackie is the cutest dog you've ever seen, so now let's learn a little about his personality! Jackie is a 4.5-year-old Pittie mix with so much love to give. Jackie really enjoys making friends and leaning in for some good cuddles; he's even done well meeting kids! This guy is still getting used to new spaces and isn't certain about new dogs, so he may need your help to make it through, but with the amount of love he offers, we have no doubt it'll work out! Jackie's also a great dog who doesn't need much to be happy! He's down to be a couch potato if that's your preference and if you want to walk, he'll try it out. He just wants his people, his toys, his food, and a safe place to land. If you have the heart to take on sweetheart Jackie, come meet this guy today.

name: Little Biscuit
description: Little Biscuit is an 9-month-old Shepherd mix who's always jumping for joy! This young fellow is learning how to be the best adult dog he can be. With all of the puppy energy he has inside, sometimes he just wants to get it out with wiggles, jumps, or playtime but he's learning that mental enrichment like puzzle toys can also get out his energy! Little Biscuit is building confidence with new people each day. He may not want to be your BFF at first, but with some treats and playtime, he warms up fast. Once he likes you, he loves cuddle time and running around by your side. He can be gentle with those who need it and energetic if you wish. He's just ready to learn more and more by your side. Come meet him and see just why we named him Little Biscuit!

name: Marcus
description: Marcus is currently in a foster home. Sign up to meet him through our Virtual Adoption Program! His adoption fee has been generously sponsored. Senior sweetie Marcus is a 10.5-year-old Lab mix who's ready to find a place where he can live out his golden years. Marcus is a quiet companion who prefers a slow life; one where he can lay by your feet and take in each passing day at his own pace. With his people, Marcus is a friendly yet calm fellow who can get along with other dogs and who's already quite well trained. Despite his truly sweet personality, Marcus is a bit nervous about new people and how much they want to touch him. He wants an owner who will advocate for him and teach people that going at his pace is the best way to become his friend. You'll start small with snacks that he never has to share, but you can work your way up to falling in love! If you want to watch a senior sweetie open up and enjoy every passing day, come meet Marcus.

name: Mitch
description: It's time for you to meet Mitch! Mitch is a 1-year-old Shepherd mix who has one true passion in life: fetch. You see, for Mitch, ball is life. This guy adores to play fetch and is looking for a home with the potential to purchase him some very fun ball-esque toys that he may play with. Mitch particularly enjoys what we call, “big fetch,” where he gets to play with an even bigger ball! Being a teen dog, Mitch still has energy to get out. He may jump to say hello but he's learning that humans give you great rewards like snacks or fetch when you can greet everyone a little more politely. If you want a fun, young, energetic dog, Mitch is your guy. He would like to request no less than 1 fetch session per day. Are you on board? Meet him today!

name: Prescott
description: Prescott's adoption fee has been generously sponsored! Say good morning and hello to our big, sweet boy, Prescott! Prescott is a 4.5-year-old Shepherd mix with a huge smile and a wonderfully goofy personality. He loves to explore, show off his zoomies, and give kisses. He also may approach you with a big stuffie toy in his mouth which is truly far too adorable! This big boy does have a habit of coming on a bit strong with both people and dogs (he just doesn't know his size!) but with positive reinforcement, he's learning to keep all paws on the floor and not pull toward unfamiliar pups. Regardless, he'll be incredibly affectionate with his people, leaning in for each and every butt scratch. If you want a big, sweet baby who's going to smile every day, come meet Prescott!

name: Robin
description: Robin is a 1-year-old Hound mix who made the long journey from Fresno Humane Animal Services to find his perfect home here in the Bay Area. This enthusiastic boy has been greatly looking forward to his debut on our website. When he sees a new friend, he can't help but jump for joy — a habit he is actively unlearning. Now, Robin's able to sit for joy or even wiggle for joy, sans the getting-all-up-in-your-face-ness of his previous introductions. He's a fast learner, a sweet dog, and ready to be your best friend. Come meet Robin today; he'll be robbin' your heart soon!

name: Roxy
description: It's Roxy time! Roxy is an endlessly lovable 1-year-old Australian Cattle Dog mix who came our way from Fresno Animal Center. Friendly to all, Roxy adores meeting new people and showing off her adorable wiggles. She may lay her head in your lap or follow you around the house to show her love and she's done phenomenally with everyone she's met here! Roxy's looking for a new family who will help her settle into city life and learn all kinds of things about San Francisco. Dolores Park? Yes, please! Walking the bridge? She's interested! Any day can be an adventure with Roxy just like how she's a perfect fit for any home. If you want a girl who is sweet and easy, Roxy's your perfect match!

name: Sirius
description: Sirius is the perfect boy! This senior sweetheart is an 11-year-old Chihuahua mix who adores living life! His foster parent said, “Beware! This charmer will perform a meerkat act to convince his audience that he deserves attention. He is excellent at letting humans know what he needs.” Tell us that's not adorable. You can't. Sirius is looking for a home who are ready to be obsessed with him, as he will be obsessed with you. He loves walking although may give a little bark to say hello to other dogs. He also adores small plushies (especially when used for tug of war) and he thinks he is a people; preferring to eat his food off of a plate. So distinguished. If you want a senior sweetie who shows no signs of slowing down, Sirius may be your perfect match. Come meet him today!

name: Stripe
description: Say hey to Stripe: a dashing boy who will make you think, “Why did they name him that when he's actually spotted?” Stripe is a truly gorgeous 1.5-year-old Shepherd mix who came our way from Fresno Animal Center. Fresh off the van and in a new environment, Stripe was already showing off his lovely, happy-go-lucky personality. This boy loves playtime and all things stuffed! He's looking for a long-term BFF who will keep him stocked in snacks and toys plus add some training. He can be a bit forward on leash but he's a smart boy and a fast learner. Plus, he loves to plop right down next to you while you're chilling on the couch. Do you want a gorgeous guy who will never stop smiling? Meet Stripe!

name: Tip Toe
description: She's going to Tip Toe her way into your heart. Meet Tip Toe, a shy yet sweet 1.5-year-old Lab mix who came to us from Fresno Humane Animal Services. Coming off of the van, Tip Toe learned that city living is fast-paced and loud, so she's taking her time to settle into this new environment and learn how she fits into the world. Tip Toe is looking for an adopter who's ready to take it slow and match her pace as she builds her confidence. This sweetheart has decided that other dogs aren't her cup of tea, so asks that she's the only pup at home, but she'll more than make up for it with the love, dedication, and adoration she offers. If you want a darling girl who needs your help to feel safe, come meet Tip Toe!

name: Toby
description: It's Toby time! Toby is a beautiful Shepherd mix who, at 3.5 years old, knows who he is and is ready to show you! Toby is a confident, curious guy who adores making friends with anyone. He gets along with kids, adults, and other dogs! He'd love to be your kids' play companion, your dog's furry friend, or your adventure assistant; regardless of his role, he'll play it to perfection! Toby is a smart boy who's going to be a joy for any home. He's treat motivated and already knows his cues like sit, down, and more! He loves having a training session and winding down with some pets from his people. He adores walks, smiles, and all things positive. If you want a dog who will never mess with the vibe, Toby's your guy! Come meet him today!

name: Tulip
description: Tulip is currently in a foster home. Sign up to meet her through our Virtual Adoption Program! Her adoption fee has been generously sponsored. Are you looking for fresh flowers? Look no further than the underbite queen herself – Tulip! Tulip is a great and gorgeous companion; just ask her foster parents! She takes a few days to warm up, but once she does, she blooms! When she's safe and snuggled in your home, she becomes an absolute lovebug who adores her people more than anything. Tulip is whip-smart and knows her cues like no one else! She's the perfect candidate for some training and already knows wonderful leash manners. Dogs make her nervous, but she can trust you to keep her safe and pass them calmly. That being said, she'd still like to avoid sharing a home with another animal and have the spotlight all to herself. Tulip has a strong friendship with her foster parents which shows just how sweet she can be in the home. She's looking for a dedicated family that will nurture her with patience and treats. We're confident this special flower will blossom in the right home. Come in and meet her today!

name: Uncle Fester
description: This dog’s adoption fees have been generously sponsored. He's ooky, but he ain't spooky: it's Uncle Fester! Fester is a 3.5-year-old Bulldog mix who came our way from Fresno Humane Animal Services. Despite his powerful exterior, Uncle Fester is a goofball at heart — just like his TV counterpart. Uncle Fester's sweet and gentle; always excited to invite new guests into his manor. Despite this, he would prefer to be the only pet in the home, so he can remain an endlessly interesting topic of conversation. He is an Addams after all… Despite what his name suggests, he isn't sure how he feels about the dark but, by your side, he can do anything. Now, whose uncle is he? We're not sure. But we are sure that he's a wonderful dog. Come meet him today!
